notes: A new Home on phone, TV and desktop: a carousel with title logos, ratings from several sites and a short overview, Continue watching, and rows of single videos and shows that fill from your chats and open at once from your last visit. Free up space as one review on every device: what TMPlayer uses, what is free, and one button that asks first before removing a download. Save to folder for one video or a selection, with Select all and a check against the folder's free space. Search waits until you stop typing and shows a title once, however often it was posted. Pictures arrive smoothly: a soft preview first, then the sharp picture fades in. Appearance: your own accent colour, high contrast, a choice of typeface and a live preview. Subtitles: colour, edge, typeface, weight and box darkness, remembered languages per series. Hide a chat from TMPlayer, and one Sort and filter menu in every chat. Player: Even out volume on by default, clearer dialogue when surround is folded to stereo, scrub pictures while streaming, faster starts and seeks. Android: XviD, DivX, VC-1 and Motion JPEG videos play, and Try the other decoder when one will not. Haptics on phones, quieter messages, trailers in the YouTube app, a lighter copy on TVs that struggle, and opt-in crash reports on every platform.
